verdict.rationale: Reducto bills itself as an agentic document platform with agentic parse modes and multi-step workflows, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers' tools is a fair question. The pack only shows Reducto acting as an MCP server for other clients such as Claude, Cursor and Codex. That is the opposite role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Reducto connecting to or using third-party MCP servers.
